rows.ARS:
Dark red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: BARmar
rows.Bloom: Dark red. Strong fragrance. Double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: This rose is named for the wife of the famous Italian sculptor, Marino Marini (1901-1980). It is a dark velvety red.
